description: The deposit describes building heat-demand estimates and an existing district-heating network for expansion planning in Ospitaletto. It lists 1,957 buildings, 17 building attributes and 21 pipe segments, with two demand-and-distance prioritisation criteria. The provider is Menapace, Andrea; Paradiso, Rosanna. Coverage: Coverage is Ospitaletto in Lombardy, Italy, at building and pipe-segment level. Annual heating demand is represented; the reference observation year is not specified. Access: The depositor publishes the record and its file listing on Zenodo. Only metadata was read; the files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence and public access. Any separately cited input data retain their own terms. Limitations: The description is a depositor statement, not independent verification of results or reusable software. File completeness and execution remain untested. For simulation it can supply network geometry and estimated building demand for district-heating expansion scenarios. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network modelling. This thematic link does not establish use by the authors.
